items: Backup and recommended TV guides now find a match's sports channel, like TNT Sports for a Premier League game.
A sports channel whose own listings don't name the teams uses a backup guide's listings that do.
The guide reloads straight away when your backup guides change.

description: Find the match. Fix the stream. Keep watching. Amaviro is a TV player for iPhone, iPad, Mac and Apple TV that finds the channel showing your game and sorts out what goes wrong, on the TV service you already pay for.
